verdict.rationale: Discord's interactions docs cover the core of the story: buttons as customizable clickable components, modals as pop-up forms that collect data, and message components that let users invoke apps natively in chat. The Embedded App SDK adds richer interactive experiences inside Discord. Structured message layouts are covered only by the general 'message components' mention, with no detail on layout primitives. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of structured message layout components (e.g. layout/container components or select menus), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build apps with rich interactive UI inside chat — modals, buttons, and structured message layouts

citations.quote: Buttons are clickable components that can be customized with different styles, texts, and emoji.
Modals are single-user pop-up interfaces that allow apps to collect form-like data.
Interactive features like commands and message components allows users to invoke an app natively within Discord.
creating rich, immersive, and interactive experiences that live directly within Discord
